pendingItems.reason: No direct local WordNet synset establishes revise as exam-study/revision; the supplied signal is insufficient for a stable new identity.
“服务” is underspecified across direct service verb synsets (be used by, maintain, and animal mating); a stable target sense cannot be selected.
The direct score noun anchor is “a set of twenty”; the broad label “大量” may be the idiom “scores of,” so a separate stable sense is not confirmed.
Local WordNet has spend as a verb only; no direct noun identity for “花销” is supplied.
“设置” could mean a physical setting/adjustment or a software configuration; the local direct setting synsets do not establish the requested product/configuration sense.
Two distinct direct verb senses are plausible (attach a code vs convert language into code); the normalized label does not choose one.
Local WordNet has folk as noun senses but no direct adjective identity for “民间的/民俗的.”
The two existing mention verb senses are near-duplicate “make reference/make mention” structures; merging would be an identity/state migration decision and is not made here.
Local WordNet provides a noun muscle-injury sense for strain but no direct verb “扭伤” anchor; do not invent one.
Substantial has adjective synsets only in the local WordNet evidence; the requested noun “本质” has no stable direct identity.
Local WordNet has fun as noun senses but no direct adjective identity for “有趣的/好玩的.”
The imagine verb candidate is anchored, but “拍照” lacks a direct local WordNet picture verb identity; the item remains partially blocked.
